description_en: Event notifications support automatically sending messages to the CloudMonitor monitoring service, MNS topics, and MNS queues after specified types of events occur, which helps you keep track of scaling group dynamics and further implement automated management. If the current event notification types no longer meet your business requirements, you can invoke the ModifyNotificationConfiguration API operation to modify auto scaling event and resource change notifications in Auto Scaling. You do not need to create a new event notification, but modifying the notification method of an event notification is not supported
description_zh: 事件通知支持在发生指定类型的事件后，自动发送消息到云监控、MNS主题和MNS队列，可以帮助您及时掌握伸缩组的动态，进一步实现自动化管理。如果当前事件通知的类型不再满足业务需求，您可以调用API ModifyNotificationConfiguration修改弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知，您无需重新创建新的事件通知，但不支持修改事件通知的通知方式
kebab_example: aliyun ess create-notification-configuration --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --notification-arn acs:mns:cn-beijing:1614568843400000:queue/modifyLifecycleHo0000 --notification-type AUTOSCALING:SCALE_OUT_SUCCESS --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNotificationConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The identity of the Notification Recipient. The Settings for this parameter support the following notification methods:

CloudMonitor monitoring. Format: `acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`.
MNS queue. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
MNS topic. Format: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.

Variables in the formats:
`region-id`: the ID of the region where the scaling group resides.
`account-id`: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
`queuename`: the name of the MNS queue.
`topicname`: the name of the MNS topic
parameters.help_zh:
通知对象标识符，设置本参数时支持以下通知方式：

云监控，参数取值格式：`acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`。
MNS队列，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
MNS主题，参数取值格式：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：
`region-id`：伸缩组所在的地域的ID。
`account-id`：阿里云账号ID。
`queuename`：MNS队列的名称。
`topicname`：MNS主题的名称
parameters.name: notification_arn

parameters.help_en: The types of Auto Scaling events and resource changes that trigger notifications. Valid values of N: 1 to 8. Specify multiple values in a repeated list format
parameters.help_zh: 一类或者多类弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知。N的取值范围：1~8，多个取值使用重复列表的形式
parameters.name: notification_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The time zone for notifications. Specify the time zone offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), such as UTC+8 or UTC-7
parameters.help_zh:
消息通知的时区。
时区相对于协调世界时的偏移量： 如 UTC+8（东八区）、UTC-7（西七区）等
parameters.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en:
The encoding method for the notification content. Valid values:

PlainText: no encoding. The content is transmitted in plaintext.
Base64: Base64 encoding.

Default value: Base64.

The Settings of this parameter are only supported for MNS Notification Recipients
parameters.help_zh:
消息通知内容的编码方式。取值范围：

PlainText：不编码，采用明文传输。
Base64：Base64 编码。

默认值：Base64。

仅支持MNS通知对象设置该参数
parameters.name: message_encoding
